author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text: Philosophy journals should judge arguments, not instruments. I have published an open letter asking them to replace blanket AI bans with disclosure requirements — and if you are a philosopher who agrees, signing is simple: comment “I sign” or repost. Full text in the article.

shared_article.title: Disclose, Don’t Ban: an open letter to philosophy journals on AI
